By Southeast Texas Record Apr 30, 2025 The Harris County Civil Court reported the following activity in the suit brought by Discover Bank and Samantha Morgan Gallivan against Eduardo Gonzalez and James B. Heston on April 23: 'Order Approving Substitution Of Mediator'.
Case number 1_1247362 was filed in the Harris County Civil Court on March 20.
